record.what_it_does: GoHighLevel (HighLevel) is an all-in-one sales/marketing CRM platform (contacts, conversations/SMS/email, calendars, opportunities, payments, workflows) whose API lets developers build integrations and automations on top of agency and sub-account data.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (with PKCE support) is used for public/Marketplace apps that act on behalf of other users' accounts, issuing daily-refreshed access tokens via /oauth/token. For single-account/internal use, HighLevel recommends static 'Private Integration Tokens' (PIT) generated in account settings and sent as a Bearer token, which replace the deprecated v1 API keys ('Other' = legacy API key, end-of-life, no longer issuable).
record.access_notes: Signing up for a Marketplace developer account is free, but to actually authorize an OAuth app or create a Private Integration Token you need a HighLevel sub-account/agency, which requires a paid subscription (Starter $97/mo, Unlimited $297/mo, Agency Pro $497/mo) — each plan ships with a 14-day free trial, after which billing starts automatically.
record.main_blocker: requires a paid (or trial) HighLevel subscription/location to obtain working credentials
